title: Hybrid Offline-Online Multi-Agent Decision Transformers for Wireless Resource Management
abstract: arXiv:2608.28878v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper develops a hybrid offline-online multi-agent reinforcement learning framework based on decision transformers. The policy is first pretrained offline via supervised sequence modeling of trajectories generated by existing policies, providing a safe and sample-efficient initialization. It is then fine-tuned online using a hybrid objective that incorporates critic-guided gradients, enabling performance improvements beyond the offline policy. To facilitate stable offline-to-online transfer and effective multi-agent coordination, the framework incorporates return-weighted sampling, a critic conditioned on neighbors' actions, and neighborhood-correlated exploration. The approach is fully distributed: both training and execution rely only on local observations and limited information exchange among neighboring agents. translated_title: 面向无线资源管理的混合离线-在线多智能体决策Transformer
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种基于决策Transformer的混合离线-在线多智能体强化学习框架。该策略首先通过对现有策略生成的轨迹进行监督式序列建模进行离线预训练，从而获得安全且样本高效的初始化。随后，采用融合评论家引导梯度的混合目标函数进行在线微调，实现超越离线策略的性能提升。为促进稳定的离线到在线迁移以及有效的多智能体协调，该框架引入了回报加权采样、以邻居动作为条件的评论家以及邻域相关探索机制。该方法是完全分布式的：无论是训练还是执行，都仅依赖于局部观测和相邻智能体之间的有限信息交换。在动态业务到达的场景下，论文在两种设置中进行了评估：(i) 联合调度与功率分配，以及 (ii) 协调……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于决策Transformer的混合离线-在线多智能体强化学习框架，通过离线预训练与评论家引导的在线微调相结合，并借助回报加权采样、邻居条件评论家和邻域相关探索，实现了完全分布式、安全且样本高效的无线资源管理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid offline-online multi-agent decision transformer framework that combines offline pretraining with critic-guided online fine-tuning, enabling fully distributed, safe, and sample-efficient wireless resource management through return-weighted sampling, neighbor-conditioned critics, and neighborhood-correlated exploration.
